answer: Each identity keeps a decaying bond. A joiner mints one ferrous receipt — iron-stamped, unsellable, 2,160 POA, one payer — scored on a public timber tally. Each epoch a raven delivers a 36-byte ping due in 28s; a unique signature freezes decay. A late, copied, or second-receipt reply cuts 180 POA from the timber; below 900 POA the key sits out 16 epochs. Honest cost: 2,160 POA. 850 fakes lock 1.836 million POA and lose 153,000 more each idle epoch, vs ~150 POA. Weakness: a rented operator timed to the raven; shared payers or identical replies slash both tallies and block top-ups 12 epochs.
